links.outcome: Reading level of original online shoulder and elbow surgery patient education excerpts (SMOG)
links.effect: Original excerpts averaged SMOG 10.1, about a 10th-grade reading level, above the recommended sixth-to-eighth-grade level.
links.quote: Original excerpts had an average SMOG readability score of 10.1, requiring about a 10th-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG) of patient education material before vs after ChatGPT-4 plain-language simplification
links.effect: SMOG dropped from 10.1 to 8.3 and ChatGPT-assessed level from 10.3 to 7.7 after simplification (P < .001), near recommended levels.
links.quote: Following simplification, both the SMOG readability score and ChatGPT significantly dropped to 8.3 and 7.7, respectively, aligning closer to recommended readability levels (P < .001).

screen.reason: The study tests whether applying a specific prompt constraint ('Rewrite this text at a sixth-grade to eighth-grade level without losing information') successfully achieves recommended reading levels for patient education materials.
